report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is unverified. Current telemetry is healthy: order logs show 200/ok, gateway /v1/checkout returns 200, and metrics show no 502s on /v1/orders. The only deployment record is baseline 1.0.0 with no prior version, which cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No error evidence exists to bound a root cause; hand off for more data.
missing_evidence: No error/failure telemetry: order logs show only 200/ok results; no 5xx or checkout error records observed.
No deployment record showing a faulty or changed version; only baseline-order-v1 1.0.0 with previous_version null.
No evidence linking any deployment to checkout errors; deployment record cannot establish causation.
Gateway checkout logs show only 200 responses; no failing checkout traces to substantiate the operator hypothesis.
